$comment: Agent-side hooks for NOW. Two scopes are mixed here on purpose and the split is docs/rule-scopes.md. NOW-SCOPED: the main guardrail, which is true of this whole repository and is the Claude Code half of AGENTS.md > Git (the git half is .githooks/pre-commit). ARC-SCOPED, and mis-placed: the Mirror drive loop (tools/mirror-gate, docs/mirror-drive-loop.md) and the Toolbox/GWorld research arc (tools/toolbox-re-gate) belong to one subsystem and one arc, not to every worktree — each is inert unless its own state file exists, so a session running neither pays only two interpreter starts, but Claude Code has no per-subdirectory hook scope, so relocating them means arming them per run instead. See docs/rule-scopes.md > MIRROR-SCOPED.
